title: /get omits properties the spec requires to be present
description: Optional/skip_serializing fields omitted where spec wants a value: CalendarEvent isDraft/useDefaultAlerts/isOrigin/calendarIds (calendars-33 ~1482 MUST be included), FileNode executable/isSubscribed, chat slowModeSeconds/permissionOverrides, Email keywords {}. Happens on create too. Found in JMAP-sofk audit.
notes:
Partial: fixed CalendarEvent isDraft/useDefaultAlerts, File mediaType/executable, channel slowModeSeconds/permissionOverrides, Mailbox.role. Blocked by existing tests pinning omission (need user decision): Email.keywords (email_minimal_roundtrip), FileNode.isSubscribed (filenode_nullable_fields_serialize_as_null_not_absent, spec_3_1_5_example_round_trips), Identity replyTo/bcc (identity_null_optional_fields_omitted_in_serialization, identity_minimal_roundtrip), Mailbox.parentId (mailbox_inbox_roundtrip). CalendarEvent isOrigin/calendarIds split to server bead.

Remaining four now fixed per user decision: Email.keywords, FileNode.isSubscribed, Identity replyTo/bcc, Mailbox.parentId always serialize with spec defaults; six tests updated to expect defaults. Server part split to JMAP-9iio.
